title: Project Public-Presentation Persistence
summary: Persist SESH-044 project public-presentation state independently from canonical SeshMusicProject payloads using a dedicated SESH_DB table and repository.
invariants: Publication state remains outside the canonical SeshMusicProject payload.
No row is equivalent to not-public.
Only an explicit row with state public may later authorize anonymous presentation.
Repository reads and writes validate canonical project, creator, state, and timestamp values.
The persisted ownerCreatorId is immutable for a project publication record.
Changing private/public state does not modify project ownership.
Changing private/public state grants no copyright, composition, master, publishing, distribution, label, management, royalty, licensing, collaborator, legal, or commercial rights.
This step creates persistence only; it creates no authenticated mutation operation and no anonymous public project API.
The migration is authored locally but is not executed in this step.
No deployment occurs in this step.

repository.getByProjectId: read explicit publication record or not-found
repository.save: create the first explicit publication record
repository.update: change state only when the persisted ownerCreatorId matches
